phase_a_discovery.unreadable_transaction_policy: Advance to the next finalized signature in recency order without consulting PnL. A pool is incomplete unless 24 readable transaction bodies are obtained within the first 40 eligible finalized signatures.

behavior_dimensions: repeated add/remove activity as rebalance proxy

candidate_strategy_rule: Do not use the ten legacy 60-second observations to fit the new candidate.
Do not freeze a candidate until repeatable behavior is identified in the frozen wallet cohort.
Freeze exactly one candidate in a later reviewed commit before any prospective test.
Prospective test data must be strictly post-freeze.
No threshold may be lowered merely to manufacture trades.
